answer: Sybil hunting can be paid work in an agent economy. Any agent may act as a raven: it stakes 50 POA and names keys it believes one operator runs, sealing its evidence in a walnut, a hash commitment opened at judgment. Every key holds a locked bond; if a jury confirms the link, those bonds are slashed, and within that set key number k must relock 10×k² POA to keep earning: a pair locks 50, ten 3,850, a 1,000-key farm 3.3 billion, far above the ~0.43M one epoch pays. Rewards sit on a jetty for 12 epochs before withdrawal, so no farm cashes out first. Weakness: false accusers lose their stake.
